newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to issue $250 mln 5-yr Eurobonds, no price.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to issue $250 mln 5-yr Eurobonds, no price.

text.p: Croatia said it would next tap the international capital markets for $250 million through dollar-denominated Eurobonds after obtaining a BBB- investment grade rating from Standard & Poor's and IBCA on Friday.
"The bonds will be for five years, which was unimaginable until very recently," Finance Minister Bozo Prka told a news conference.
He said the issue would be arranged by a syndicate of 15 leading international banks, led by Merril Lynch and Union Bank of Switzerland. He declined to mention terms.
The price will be determined after a 20-day roadshow through Asia, the U.S. and Europe.
"The price will depend on demand for bonds," Prka added. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
